selection_method: Frozen from full-rate raw encoder and independently clock-mapped camera geometry before any model fit/scoring. All six releases retained. Held-pose, release onset and free-decay intervals visually inspected; exclude manual lift and settled static tails. Operator reports free releases; no movie exists to prove exact hand-clear time. Start free interval about0.1s after observed release. Missing camera and unstable poses intentionally remain unverified; no replacement by later peaks or interval optimization against prediction error.
